definitions: A state in the Midwestern United States, bordered by the Mississippi River to the east and the Missouri River and Big Sioux River to the west.
A river in the United States, a tributary of the Mississippi River.
A member of a Native American people originally inhabiting the area that is now the state of Iowa.
examples: She moved to Iowa last year.
The Iowa River flows through the state.
The Iowa people have a rich history.
